make deploy rewrites the tracked deploy-marker.txt in the workspace before rsyncing; the next deploy's forced checkout resets it. The marker is never committed by the bot, so the repo's copy stays stale as before.

deploy.name: indexnow ping
deploy.note: make deploy runs this with a leading dash: a refused or unreachable IndexNow is reported in the log and the deploy stands. make indexnow sends the list again.

rollback.name: previous release
rollback.note: Switches current back to the previous release. Only after the live check fails, because that is the only step that fails after the release went live; a failure in upload either published nothing or switched itself back, and make rollback there would step the live site back one release for no reason. The default (redeploy the previous commit) cannot work for this engine: the engine refuses a HEAD behind origin/main.
